description: Remove a custom domain from the profile: it stops showing the publication and its slot is free at once. The BrewPage link keeps working. Addressed by publication (type, namespace, id; a profile token or an owner token added to the profile) or by hostname (an admin profile token). DNS records at the DNS provider stay until the domain owner deletes them.

hostname.description: Custom domain as a bare hostname, e.g. www.example.com; instead of type, namespace and id

ownerToken.description: By publication: a profile token or an owner token added to the profile. By hostname: an admin profile token. Default: env BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN (local server only).

type.description: Publication type; with namespace and id, instead of hostname

name: remove_domain
title: Remove custom domain
